newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Medical device firms rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Medical device firms rated buy.

text.p: -- Edward Jones analyst Bill Fiala said Wednesday he initiated coverage of medical device companies Medtronic Inc, St. Jude Medical Inc and Guidant Corp with buy ratings.

-- In a report, Fiala said Medtronic has established itself over the years as the market leader in pacemakers for the heart. It also ranks first of second in market shares for 10 of its 14 different product lines.
-- He added Guidant has the leading market share in one of its fastest growing device areas -- defibrillators.

-- Fiala said St. Jude has established itself over the years as the market leader in mechanical heart valves. The St. Jude mechanical heart ranks number one and its Pacesetters subsidiary ranks number two in pacemakers in terms of market share.
-- St. Jude shars were unchanged at 41-1/2.
